Nina: Quick public kudos: Carlos jumped into the customer demo call this morning at 06:30 PT to fix the auth token issue. Saved the day. :star2:
Carlos: It was a team scramble but glad it worked out. The token rotation script had a bad edge-case. Pulled a hotfix and redeployed.
Yuki: I could hear the relief through my headphones. Huge thanks. That customer literally said 'wow you all move fast'.
Matt: Also shoutout to Nina who stayed calm and handled the Q&A while Carlos was in the weeds. Multitasking MVP. :clap:
People-Ops: Adding both Carlos and Nina to this week's kudos email. Also sending a $30 lunch voucher to Carlos and a "Calm Under Fire" sticker to Nina.
Carlos: Aww, thank you! No voucher necessary but I will take the sticker. :grin:
Legal-Bot: Note: recording from 2025-09-12T13:06:00Z tagged for demo review. Transcripts attached to the customer folder.
Nina: Extra thanks to Matt for grabbing the updated privacy slide from drive and dropping it into the deck at 06:25. That saved an awkward silence.
Matt: Happy to help. If anyone wants a 5-min primer on the token edge-case I can post a gist.
Yuki: Please yes. Also proposal: tiny "Demo Support" rota for early/late calls so we can share the love (and snacks).
Office-Pettycash: Expense recorded: 1x coffee for Carlos - reimbursed by team fund. :coffee:
Carlos: Team coffee accepted. Thanks everyone for the quick comms. Makes a huge difference during late-early calls.
People-Ops: Heartwarming thread. We'll add a short blurb and a screenshot to the monthly "what warmed our hearts" digest. :sparkling_heart:
